name: week
title: This week
subtitle: SMSF Admin for Claude Code: pensions, caps, jobs and the audit, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Pensions behind on this year's minimum
sections.note: Nothing paid yet, or less than the year so far calls for.
sections.sql: select fund, number as pension, member, aud(minimum) as minimum, aud(paid) as paid, aud(left_to_pay) as left_to_pay, days_left as days_to_30_june from pension_status where fy = cur_fy() and left_to_pay > 0 and paid < minimum * greatest(0, (current_date - fy_start(fy))::numeric / 365 - 1.0 / 12) order by left_to_pay desc

sections.title: Members over or near a contribution cap
sections.sql: select fund, member, aud(concessional) as concessional, aud(concessional_room) as concessional_room, aud(non_concessional) as non_concessional, aud(ncc_room) as ncc_room from contribution_room where fy = cur_fy() and (concessional_room < 5000 or ncc_room < 0) order by concessional_room

sections.title: Jobs late, stuck or close to their lodgment date
sections.sql: select fund, fy, stage, days_in_stage, assigned, due_on, days_to_due, open_queries from job_board where stage <> 'lodged' and (days_to_due < 45 or days_in_stage > 21) order by days_to_due

sections.title: Audit queries open
sections.sql: select q.number, b.fund, q.waiting_on, current_date - q.raised_on as days_open, q.question from audit_queries q join job_board b on b.job_id = q.job_id where q.status = 'open' order by q.raised_on

sections.title: Bank lines to code
sections.sql: select f.code as fund, t.txn_on, aud(t.amount) as amount, t.description from transactions t join funds f on f.id = t.fund_id where t.kind = 'uncoded' order by t.txn_on

name: pensions
title: Pensions
subtitle: This year's minimums, the TTR maximum and what has been paid

sections.title: This year
sections.sql: select fund, number as pension, member, kind, age, percent || '%' as factor, aud(opening_balance) as balance, aud(minimum) as minimum, aud(maximum) as ttr_maximum, aud(paid) as paid, aud(left_to_pay) as left_to_pay, last_paid_on from pension_status where fy = cur_fy() order by fund, number

sections.title: Last year
sections.note: Any line with something left to pay did not meet the pension standards for the year.
sections.sql: select fund, number as pension, member, aud(minimum) as minimum, aud(paid) as paid, aud(left_to_pay) as short_by from pension_status where fy = fy_shift(cur_fy(), -1) order by left_to_pay desc

name: jobs
title: The job board
subtitle: Last year's work on every fund, from records request to lodgment

sections.title: By stage
sections.sql: select stage, count(*) as funds, sum(open_queries) as open_queries, aud(sum(fee)) as fees from job_board where fy = fy_shift(cur_fy(), -1) group by stage order by array_position(array['not-started','records-requested','records-in','in-progress','review','with-auditor','audit-queries','signed','lodged'], stage)

sections.title: Every job
sections.sql: select fund, name, stage, days_in_stage, assigned, due_on, days_to_due, open_queries, hours, aud(fee) as fee, aud(margin) as margin from job_board where fy = fy_shift(cur_fy(), -1) order by due_on
